plain_english: Flowers and all in order — emblem or altar; with fourteen mutterings, a flower-seat made.
sanskrit_cite: puṣpādikaṃ kramāt sarvaṃ liṅge vā sthaṇḍile'thavā caturdaśābhijaptena puṣpeṇāsanakalpanā |

plain_english: There let the hero worship the forthgoing, then the seat again; casketed, let him begin the worship after.
sanskrit_cite: tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ yajedvīraḥ punarevāsanaṃ tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ tu saṃpuṭīkṛtya punaryajanamārabhet |

plain_english: Full of all realities, graced with all ornaments — let the great lady worship the goddess, twenty-seven-named.
Then with fragrant flowers, as able, let him honor; worship with supreme devotion, and offer up himself.
sanskrit_cite: tataḥ sugandhipuṣpaistu yathāśaktyā samarcayet pūjayet parayā bhaktyā ātmānaṃ ca nivedayet |

plain_english: Thus worship told; in fire-rite too this rule: who did the worship-rule, rightly remembering the seed, succeeds.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ yajanamākhyātamagnikārye'pyayaṃ vidhiḥ kṛtapūjāvidhiḥ samyak smaran bījaṃ prasidhyati |

plain_english: Beginningless-endless seed, abloom, gone mid-tithis — housed in the heart-lotus, meditate the moon-ray, ever practise.
sanskrit_cite: ādyantarahitaṃ bījaṃ vikasattithimadhyagam hṛtpadmāntargataṃ dhyāyet somāṃśaṃ nityamabhyaset |

plain_english: Which desires he desires, them quickly may he win; from this he goes to direct sight — all-knowingness, no doubt.
sanskrit_cite: yānyān kāmayate kāmāṃstāṃstāṃ śīghramavāpnuyāt asmāt pratyakṣatāmeti sarvajñatvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |

plain_english: Thus is mantra-fruit got — this Rudrayāmala; from this practice, accomplishment and all-knowingness are won.
